sample_limitations_legend.Very Low Sample (<6 balls): Exploratory sample (<6 balls). Single-event volatility dominates signal. Do NOT draw tactical conclusions.
sample_limitations_legend.Low Sample (6-17 balls): Early sample (6-17 balls). Useful for tactical orientation only; high confidence intervals.
sample_limitations_legend.Moderate Sample (18-29 balls): Indicative sample (18-29 balls). Emerging tactical trend with moderate statistical power.
sample_limitations_legend.Robust Sample (>=30 balls): Statistically reliable sample (>=30 balls). High statistical confidence for head-to-head match-up planning.
